evals.name: insert-priority-matrix
evals.prompt: Can you print me the priority matrix page so I can fill it in on paper?
evals.expected_output: An A5 PDF of the blank priority-matrix insert, presented to the user.

assertions.text: Produced at least one PDF file
The PDF page size is A5 (595x420 or 420x595 points)
Ran make_insert.py with the priority-matrix page (not a different page)

evals.name: insert-multi-page
evals.prompt: give me the sleep page and the weekly schedule to print out
evals.expected_output: Two blank A5 inserts (sleep-activities and weekly-schedule), or one combined PDF containing both.

assertions.text: All produced PDFs are A5 sized

evals.name: plan-day-around-meetings
evals.prompt: Time-block my day for June 30 2026. Tasks: write the report (60 min), review pull requests (45 min), prep 1:1 notes (25 min). My meetings today are a standup 10:00-10:30 and a client call 12:00-13:00.
evals.expected_output: A timed checklist that places 25/5 Pomodoro focus blocks around the two meetings and the protected lunch, with all three tasks scheduled.

assertions.text: Produced a timed checklist / plan (plan-<date>.md or equivalent shown to the user)
No focus block overlaps the standup 10:00-10:30
No focus block overlaps the client call 12:00-13:00
Lunch 14:00-15:00 is protected (no focus block overlaps it)
All three tasks appear in the schedule (or any leftover is explicitly reported)
Focus blocks are ~25 minutes (Pomodoro), not one giant block per task
